title: agent-testbench run report, version 1
description: report.json of a run: what ran, on which code and machine, what passed and failed and why, what it cost, and the evidence it left. Fields may be added in later versions; readers should ignore fields they do not know.

backend.description: local, modal, colab, ssh, or an installed backend

cost_usd.description: estimated: time on the hardware x its price

approved.description: a person approved a cost above the threshold

remote_stop.description: the hard stop on the remote side, in words

source.description: the project's code at launch; null outside a git repository

dirty.description: uncommitted changes or untracked files were part of the run

changes_sha256.description: sha256 of the diff against the commit and the untracked files

environment.description: where the plan's code ran (recorded on that machine)

packages_sha256.description: sha256 of the sorted name==version list

package_versions.description: every installed package's version, by lowercase name (testbench diff names the ones that changed)

evidence.description: every file under steps/ when the run was closed

evidence_sha256.description: sha256 over every evidence path and hash, in order

delta.description: against the previous finished run of the same plan; empty for the first

data.description: the data the plan's steps read, by role (testbench.yaml's data:): what the steps saw, measured where they ran, and the file it was cut from, read at launch

path.description: the file or folder, relative to the project

holdout_from.description: rows at or after this time are sealed; null when nothing is

view.description: sealed: the rows before holdout_from; full: the whole file (the holdout plan, or no seal); windows: cut per walk-forward window from the rows before the seal

bytes.description: the size of what the steps saw

sha256.description: sha256 of the bytes the steps saw (a folder: over each file's name and sha256)

first.description: the earliest time the steps saw

last.description: the latest time the steps saw

file.description: the whole file at launch, on the machine that launched the run (what `testbench verify` compares)

sealed.description: the sealed rows (at or after holdout_from) at launch; null without a seal

note.description: something to know about this data, in words

holdout.description: a run of the plan that opens the holdout: how many times the sealed rows were opened before it

opened_before.description: earlier openings whose file reached into the sealed period

roles.description: each sealed role and its holdout_from

windows.description: a walk-forward plan's windows, oldest first: each ran every step of the plan

test_end.description: the window's data holds only rows before it

status.description: passed when every step of the window passed; skipped when none ran

data.description: what the window's data files held, by role

dir.description: the step's folder, relative to the run folder

line.description: the cell line that raised it, and where it was raised

readings.description: nvidia-smi samples in the step's window

fingerprint.description: rows of a data file: their size, sha256, count and first and last time

files.description: a folder: how many CSV files
